heading: Package → Promote → Discover → Experience
subhead: Your existing services become events. Audeohost publishes them locally, helps customers discover what's relevant, and keeps them connected once they're in the venue.

moments.title: The menu, the restaurants
moments.text: Sophisticated dining - or casual fare. Promoting your dining as an event gives it a certain level of sophistication in itself. It is an experience, not to be missed.

moments.title: Hospitality Hub
moments.text:
A great place to relax with friends and equally, a great place to catch the match.
Where a game is available with sound. Sports fans say the game is 65% better with commentary. Customers will be back again when they know there is commentary.

moments.title: Gym & Pool
moments.text:
Publish the workout and swim schedules.
Customers stay connected even during a high intensity burn!

moments.title: Patient Panic or Relaxation
moments.text: Schedule patient appointments using a localised descriptor. Let patients hear about the latest treatments for their ailment from qualified physicians and manufacturers that they trust.

beatStrip: This is what Audeohost-Events was built for — not just sport, and not just a headline event, but a diary of events for customers to look forward to.
